diagnostic_propagation_probe.kind: synthetic invalid tool_result over NSXPC; no user task and no model request
diagnostic_propagation_probe.opt_in_method: XPCService.EnvironmentVariables in a disposable signed XPC fixture
diagnostic_propagation_probe.limitation: The fixture XPC bundle was re-signed after adding the per-service environment. The production product bundle remains default-off. The flag propagation proof does not prove a collectable stderr channel for the production product.

capture_gate.evidence: After local administrator authentication, the app-private embedded XPC service was not addressable by the stable launchctl debug target. A manually bootstrapped copy was a distinct service and was removed. StandardErrorPath at both tested plist locations captured 0 bytes even though the signed Host observed KHAOS_AGENT_ACTION_DIAGNOSTICS=1 and returned invalid_request.
